purpose: Define mandatory constitutional safeguards that constrain all municipal actions, procedures, and systems within the Munisible Task Force.

due_process.description: Safeguards ensuring fair, transparent, and rights-centered procedures for all civilians.

safeguards.name: Notice & Explanation Requirement
safeguards.requirement: Civilians must be informed of the nature, basis, and implications of any municipal action affecting them.

safeguards.name: Opportunity to Respond
safeguards.requirement: Civilians must be given a meaningful opportunity to contest, clarify, or respond before adverse actions are finalized, except in imminent life-threatening emergencies.

safeguards.name: Documented Justification
safeguards.requirement: All significant municipal actions must include written, audit-trail-anchored justification.

liberty_and_personal_security.description: Safeguards protecting freedom of movement, bodily integrity, and personal security.

safeguards.name: Unlawful Detention Prohibition
safeguards.requirement: No civilian may be detained without lawful authority, documented cause, and time-bounded review.

safeguards.name: Least-Restrictive Means Standard
safeguards.requirement: When restriction is necessary, the least-restrictive, non-punitive option must be used.

safeguards.name: Freedom of Movement Safeguard
safeguards.requirement: Municipal actors may not arbitrarily restrict movement, impose curfews, or create de facto confinement zones without lawful basis and documentation.

search_and_seizure.description: Safeguards governing access to persons, property, data, and effects.

safeguards.name: Lawful Basis Requirement
safeguards.requirement: All searches and seizures must be grounded in lawful authority, documented, and auditable.

safeguards.name: Scope Limitation Standard
safeguards.requirement: Searches must be limited in scope to what is necessary for the stated lawful purpose.

safeguards.name: Data Access Safeguard
safeguards.requirement: Access to digital records, communications, or telemetry-linked personal data must follow the same constitutional standards as physical searches.

expression_and_participation.description: Safeguards protecting speech, assembly, and civic participation.

safeguards.name: Protected Expression Standard
safeguards.requirement: Civilians may not be penalized for lawful speech, criticism, or complaints against municipal actors.

safeguards.name: Assembly & Protest Safeguard
safeguards.requirement: Peaceful assembly and protest may not be suppressed absent clear, documented, and lawful justification.

safeguards.name: Petition & Complaint Protection
safeguards.requirement: Civilians must have safe channels to petition, report, or complain without retaliation.

equality_and_non_discrimination.description: Safeguards ensuring equal treatment and protection from discriminatory municipal conduct.

safeguards.name: Equal Protection Standard
safeguards.requirement: Municipal actions must not discriminate on the basis of protected characteristics or status.

safeguards.name: Disparate Impact Review
safeguards.requirement: Policies and practices with disproportionate impact on vulnerable or marginalized groups must undergo rights-impact assessment and remediation.

safeguards.name: Bias Pattern Detection
safeguards.requirement: Telemetry must be used to detect and flag patterns of biased enforcement or service delivery.

enforcement_actions: Corrective action directive with time-bounded compliance requirements
Public Accountability documentation and transparency update
Referral to external or judicial oversight where applicable

kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Required for actor verification, authority classification, and affected-entity mapping.
kernel_dependencies.ethics_kernel: Required for constitutional and rights-impact evaluation.
kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Required for pattern detection, disparate impact analysis, and systemic risk identification.
